description: This file implements a command-line utility for querying and setting battery health parameters in a Cuttlefish virtual device environment. It includes functions for displaying usage, handling different battery-related commands, and executing a command to communicate with the virtual device.

methods.name: GetControlSocketPath
methods.description: Returns the control socket path for the default Cuttlefish instance based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Displays the usage information for the 'status' battery command.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Displays the usage information for the 'health' battery command.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the usage information for the 'present' battery command.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Displays the usage information for the 'capacity' battery command.

methods.name: aconline
methods.description: Displays the usage information for the 'aconline' battery command.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays general usage information for the battery health command-line utility.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program that processes command-line arguments, executes the appropriate battery command, and communicates with the virtual device.
